choices.reason: The paper explicitly describes its main analyses as including problem-solving skill and creativity as control variables. Table 1 Model (1) includes those covariates, identifying the adjusted OLS candidate as the analysis matching that designation rather than the unadjusted comparison.
choices.locator: PDF p. 8, Section 3.4.5 (Control variables), final sentence; PDF p. 9, Table 1, Model (1), Task quality, covariate rows.
choices.quote: Due to concerns of multicollinearity (as the three scores are interdependent and sum to a constant), we included only problem-solving skill and creativity as control variables in our main analyses.
